question: What was total spend in 2024?
dax: EVALUATE ROW("Total Spend", [Total Spend], "Invoiced Workers", [Invoiced Workers], "Assignments", [Assignments])
note: Companion measures returned together per the reporting rule.

question: Top 5 suppliers by spend in 2024
dax: EVALUATE TOPN(5, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dimsupplier[Supplier], TREATAS({DATE(2024,1,1)}, CALENDAR[Date]), "Total Spend", [Total Spend]), [Total Spend], DESC)
note: Ranking -> tabular output with the measure column labeled.

question: Spend per invoiced worker by Business Unit in 2024
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dimbusinessunit[Business Unit], "Spend per Invoiced Worker", [Spend per Invoiced Worker], "Invoiced Workers", [Invoiced Workers])
note: Non-additive ratio: never summed; denominator (Invoiced Workers) shown alongside and labeled.

question: SOW vs Staff Augmentation split of total spend in 2024
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dimspendtype[Spend Type], "Total Spend", [Total Spend], "% of Total Spend", [% of Total Spend])
note: Breakdown by the leadership dimension the user named.

question: What drove the change in Total Spend from 2023 to 2024?
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dimbusinessunit[Business Unit], "Spend 2023", CALCULATE([Total Spend], CALENDAR[Date].[Year]=2023), "Spend 2024", CALCULATE([Total Spend], CALENDAR[Date].[Year]=2024))
note: ::drivers pattern — decompose the delta across a leadership dimension; report absolute and % change per member.
